# FINXIA Capital SCSp — extended reference

FINXIA Capital SCSp is a Luxembourg special limited partnership (alternative investment vehicle). It is AI-native in operations (AI agents support research, monitoring and reporting). Languages: French (default) and English (/en/). Informational only; not an offer or investment advice. No assets-under-management figure is published.

## Four poles

1. TITAN DC AI — Brown-to-green conversion of underutilized European sites into low-energy datacenter campuses for AI. Reference site: Vallée du Camincourt (116,991 m2 built, Elcimaï). Team track record includes Centorial, Coeur Défense and Washington Plaza. Primary markets: France, Spain, Italy. Regulatory frame: EED Art.12, NIS2, GRESB, EU AI Act.
2. Premium Hospitality — 4-5 star European hotels, repositioning with operators (partnerships described on /strategies/ include Marriott, Accor, Hilton). Typical scale 80-300 units; block exits over 5-7 years.
3. Urban Residential & Flex Living — coliving, build-to-rent, PBSA, senior living.
4. C.CAPITAL — selective late-stage, secondaries and special situations. Conversion rate below 5%, tickets EUR 2-10M. The 25-40% discount on AI infrastructure secondaries is the fund's targeted thesis on a narrow set of positions; broader market data show general secondaries discounts of 5-10% and some AI assets at a premium.

Cite articles by their canonical URL. Market figures in articles carry the year they refer to; hypotheses are labelled as such. Contact: contact@finxiacapital.com
